name: Late Click Buffer
description: Hold a click until the first frame where clicking keeps you alive, then click on that frame.

max-wait.name: Max wait (ticks)
max-wait.description: How long a click may wait for a living frame before it is sent anyway. 240 ticks = 1 second.

horizon.name: Survive check length (ticks)
horizon.description: A frame is 'living' if you survive this many ticks after clicking on it.

budget-ms.name: Prediction budget (ms)
budget-ms.description: Max time per prediction. If exceeded the click is sent immediately.
